en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a classical pavilion-like structure, surrounded by trees in a park-like setting. The building has ornate architectural elements and steps leading up to it on both sides. There is prominent text at the top in German, referring to 'Bad Kösen a. Saale. Herzog Georg Halle (Johannes Quelle)'. The structure appears to be a well house or hall associated with a spa or mineral spring.
